rows.en: Quick start guide to the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for CAMP COORDINATION AND CAMP MANAGEMENT (CCCM) ACTORS
rows.ne: शिविर समन्वय तथा शिविर व्यवस्थापन (CCCM) का सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूका लागि MHPSS न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेजको द्रुत सुरुआत मार्गदर्शिका
rows.bt: Quick start guide to the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for camp coordination and camp management (CCCM) stakeholders

rows.section: Quick start guide to the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for CAMP COORDINATION AND CAMP MANAGEMENT (CCCM) ACTORS
rows.en: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज (MSP) भनेको के हो?
rows.bt: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.note: The clinical composite is reused from the cited unreviewed candidate T001.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: The MSP outlines priority activities to meet the mental health and psychosocial support needs of emergency-affected populations.
rows.ne: आपत्कालबाट प्रभावित जनसमुदायको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोगसम्बन्धी आवश्यकताहरू पूरा गर्न MSP ले प्राथमिकताका गतिविधिहरूको रूपरेखा प्रस्तुत गर्छ।
rows.bt: The MSP outlines priority activities to meet the mental health and psychosocial support needs of communities affected by emergencies.
rows.note: The clinical composite is reused from the cited unreviewed candidate T001.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: It is based on existing guidelines, the best available evidence, and expert consensus.
rows.ne: यो विद्यमान निर्देशिकाहरू, उपलब्ध सर्वोत्तम प्रमाण र विज्ञहरूको सहमतिमा आधारित छ।
rows.bt: It is based on existing guidelines, the best available evidence and expert consensus.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: The goal of the MSP is to contribute to reduced suffering and improved mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.ne: MSP को लक्ष्य पीडा कम गर्न तथा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणमा सुधार ल्याउन योगदान गर्नु हो।
rows.bt: The aim of the MSP is to contribute to reducing suffering and improving mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Mental health and psychosocial well-being wording is reused from the cited unreviewed candidates T100 and T005.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: For more information on what the MSP is, why it is needed and how it can be used, please refer to the MSP guide.
rows.ne: MSP के हो, यसको आवश्यकता किन पर्छ र यसलाई कसरी प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ भन्नेबारे थप जानकारीका लागि MSP मार्गदर्शिका हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For more information about what the MSP is, why it is needed and how it can be used, see the MSP guide.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: How is it relevant to Camp Coordination and Camp Management actors?
rows.ne: शिविर समन्वय तथा शिविर व्यवस्थापनका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूका लागि यो कसरी सान्दर्भिक छ?
rows.bt: How is this relevant to camp coordination and camp management stakeholders?

rows.section: How is it relevant to Camp Coordination and Camp Management actors?
rows.en: The mental health and psychosocial well-being of people residing in camps and camp-like settings is significantly impacted by the extent to which they can participate in decision-making that affects their lives, access information, and access appropriate facilities and services.
rows.ne: शिविर तथा शिविरजस्ता परिवेशमा बसोबास गर्ने मानिसहरूले आफ्नो जीवनमा असर पार्ने निर्णय प्रक्रियामा कति हदसम्म सहभागी हुन सक्छन्, सूचना प्राप्त गर्न सक्छन् र उपयुक्त सुविधा तथा सेवाहरूमा पहुँच पाउन सक्छन् भन्ने कुराले उनीहरूको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणमा उल्लेखनीय असर पार्छ।
rows.bt: The extent to which people living in camps and camp-like settings can participate in decision-making processes that affect their lives, obtain information and access appropriate facilities and services has a significant effect on their mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Mental health and psychosocial well-being wording is reused from the cited unreviewed candidates T100 and T005.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Camp Coordination and Camp Management actors?
rows.en: The distress caused by their displacement can be exacerbated or mitigated depending on the degree to which their sense of agency and independence is promoted or diminished.
rows.ne: उनीहरूमा आफ्नै निर्णय र पहलमा काम गर्न सक्ने अनुभूति तथा स्वतन्त्रताको अनुभूति कति हदसम्म बढाइन्छ वा घटाइन्छ भन्ने आधारमा, उनीहरूको विस्थापनबाट उत्पन्न व्यथा बढ्न वा कम हुन सक्छ।
rows.bt: Their distress arising from displacement may increase or decrease depending on the extent to which their sense of being able to act on their own decisions and initiative and their sense of freedom are increased or decreased.
rows.note: Distress uses the supplied candidate, and agency is expressed as a perceived ability to decide and act on one's own initiative.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Camp Coordination and Camp Management actors?
rows.en: Camp Coordination and Camp Management (CCCM) actors, through their direct and regular interaction with displaced families and communities, have a key role to play in enhancing the well-being of those living in displacement.
rows.ne: विस्थापित परिवार तथा समुदायहरूसँग प्रत्यक्ष र नियमित अन्तरक्रिया गर्ने भएकाले शिविर समन्वय तथा शिविर व्यवस्थापन (CCCM) का सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूको विस्थापित अवस्थामा बसिरहेका मानिसहरूको कल्याण बढाउन प्रमुख भूमिका हुन्छ।
rows.bt: Because they interact directly and regularly with displaced families and communities, camp coordination and camp management (CCCM) stakeholders have a key role in enhancing the well-being of people living in displacement.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Camp Coordination and Camp Management actors?
rows.en: The MSP outlines priority activities CCCM actors can implement and support to promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of people living in camps.
rows.ne: शिविरमा बसिरहेका मानिसहरूको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न CCCM का सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूले कार्यान्वयन गर्न र सहयोग पुर्‍याउन सक्ने प्राथमिकताका गतिविधिहरूको रूपरेखा MSP ले प्रस्तुत गर्छ।
rows.bt: The MSP outlines priority activities that CCCM stakeholders can implement and support to promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of people living in camps.
rows.note: Mental health and psychosocial well-being wording is reused from the cited unreviewed candidates T100 and T005.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Camp Coordination and Camp Management actors?
rows.en: How do I find CCCM content in the MSP?
rows.ne: MSP मा CCCM सम्बन्धी सामग्री कसरी फेला पार्ने?
rows.bt: How to find CCCM-related content in the MSP?

rows.section: How do I find CCCM content in the MSP?
rows.en: Each MSP activity is labelled with icons showing which sectors, clusters, or areas of responsibility (AoRs) are typically well placed to deliver it (colourful icons) or contribute to it (dark blue icons).1
rows.ne: प्रत्येक MSP गतिविधिमा प्रतीकहरू राखिएका छन्, जसले सामान्यतया कुन क्षेत्र, क्लस्टर वा जिम्मेवारीका क्षेत्रहरू (AoRs) उक्त गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् (रङ्गीन प्रतीकहरू) वा त्यसमा योगदान गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् (गाढा निलो रङका प्रतीकहरू) भन्ने देखाउँछन्।1
rows.bt: Each MSP activity has symbols that show which sectors, clusters or areas of responsibility (AoRs) are generally in a suitable position to carry out that activity (coloured symbols) or to contribute to it (dark blue symbols).1
rows.note: Proposed recurring terminology: icon = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]. The delivery/contribution distinction, both icon colours and footnote marker 1 are retained.

rows.section: How do I find CCCM content in the MSP?
rows.en: The orange CCCM icon indicates that CCCM actors are typically well-placed to deliver an activity.
rows.ne: सुन्तला रङको CCCM प्रतीकले CCCM का सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सामान्यतया कुनै गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् भन्ने जनाउँछ।
rows.bt: The orange CCCM symbol indicates that CCCM stakeholders are generally in a suitable position to carry out an activity.
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring term icon = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence], which is absent from G-0.1.

rows.section: How do I find CCCM content in the MSP?
rows.en: The dark-blue CCCM icon indicates that CCCM actors are typically well-placed to contribute to the implementation of an activity.
rows.ne: गाढा निलो रङको CCCM प्रतीकले CCCM का सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सामान्यतया कुनै गतिविधिको कार्यान्वयनमा योगदान गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् भन्ने जनाउँछ।
rows.bt: The dark blue CCCM symbol indicates that CCCM stakeholders are generally in a suitable position to contribute to the implementation of an activity.
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring term icon = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence], which is absent from G-0.1.

rows.section: How do I find CCCM content in the MSP?
rows.en: For more information, see Who should implement MSP activities?
rows.ne: थप जानकारीका लागि ‘MSP गतिविधिहरू कसले कार्यान्वयन गर्नुपर्छ?’ हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For more information, see ‘Who should implement MSP activities?’

rows.section: How do I find CCCM content in the MSP?
rows.en: Figure 1 shows activity 3.3, Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being, as an example.
rows.ne: चित्र 1 मा उदाहरणका रूपमा गतिविधि 3.3, ‘मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्ने’, देखाइएको छ।
rows.bt: Figure 1 shows activity 3.3, ‘Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being’, as an example.
rows.note: The activity label is reused verbatim from the cited unreviewed candidate T100.

rows.section: How do I find CCCM content in the MSP?
rows.en: The colourful icons show that Health, Education, Protection, Child Protection, Gender-Based Violence (GBV), Mine Action, Nutrition, and Camp Coordination and Camp Management (CCCM) actors, are typically well placed to deliver this activity.
rows.ne: रङ्गीन प्रतीकहरूले स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा, संरक्षण, बाल संरक्षण, लैङ्गिक हिंसा (GBV), बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्य, पोषण तथा शिविर समन्वय तथा शिविर व्यवस्थापन (CCCM) का सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सामान्यतया यो गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् भन्ने देखाउँछन्।
rows.bt: The coloured symbols show that stakeholders in health, education, protection, child protection, gender-based violence (GBV), landmine-related work, nutrition, and camp coordination and camp management (CCCM) are generally in a suitable position to carry out this activity.
rows.note: Reclassified as general: this describes sector roles rather than giving safety guidance. Uses the proposed recurring term icon = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence].

rows.section: How do I find CCCM content in the MSP?
rows.en: For example, CCCM actors, with support from MHPSS actors, are well placed to identify, refine and disseminate key messages on locally relevant coping skills and informal support practices.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, MHPSS का सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूको सहयोगमा CCCM का सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू स्थानीय सन्दर्भमा सान्दर्भिक कठिनाइको सामना गर्ने सीप र अनौपचारिक सहयोगका अभ्याससम्बन्धी मुख्य सन्देशहरू पहिचान गर्न, परिष्कृत गर्न र प्रसार गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन्।
rows.bt: For example, with support from MHPSS stakeholders, CCCM stakeholders are in a suitable position to identify, refine and disseminate key messages about skills for coping with difficulties and informal support practices that are relevant to the local context.
rows.note: Coping skills and informal support practices are drafted as ordinary nonclinical wording, not as named interventions. Proposed terms: coping skills = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]; informal support practices = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]. Review is pending.

rows.section: How do I find CCCM content in the MSP?
rows.en: The dark blue icons show that Shelter and Settlements, WASH and Food Security and Livelihoods actors are typically well placed to contribute to this activity, for example, by helping to disseminate the key messages developed.
rows.ne: गाढा निलो रङका प्रतीकहरूले आश्रय तथा बस्ती, WASH र खाद्य सुरक्षा तथा जीविकोपार्जनका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सामान्यतया यस गतिविधिमा योगदान गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् भन्ने देखाउँछन्; उदाहरणका लागि, उनीहरूले तयार गरिएका मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्न सहयोग गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: The dark blue symbols show that shelter and settlements, WASH, and food security and livelihoods stakeholders are generally in a suitable position to contribute to this activity; for example, they can help disseminate the key messages that have been prepared.
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring term icon = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]. WASH is retained exactly as supplied.

rows.section: How do I find CCCM content in the MSP?

rows.section: How do I find CCCM content in the MSP?
rows.en: Here the colourful icon shows that Gender-based Violence actors are typically well placed to deliver activity 3.9, Provide MHPSS through safe spaces for women and girls, while the dark blue icons show that CCCM, Shelter and Settlements, and WASH actors are typically well-placed to contribute to it.
rows.ne: यहाँ रङ्गीन प्रतीकले लैङ्गिक हिंसाका क्षेत्रमा काम गर्ने सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सामान्यतया 3.9, ‘महिला तथा किशोरीका लागि सुरक्षित स्थलमार्फत MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने’ गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुने देखाउँछ भने गाढा निलो रङका चिह्नहरूले CCCM, आश्रय तथा बस्ती, र खानेपानी, सरसफाइ तथा स्वच्छता (WASH) का क्षेत्रमा काम गर्ने सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सामान्यतया उक्त गतिविधिमा योगदान दिन उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुने देखाउँछन्।
rows.bt: Here, the coloured symbol shows that stakeholders working in the area of gender-based violence are generally well positioned to carry out activity 3.9, ‘Provide MHPSS through safe spaces for women and adolescent girls’, while the dark blue marks show that stakeholders working in the areas of CCCM, shelter and settlements, and water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) are generally well positioned to contribute to that activity.
rows.note: The frozen T106 label, which incorporates T054, uses किशोरी for girls and therefore excludes younger girls, whereas the source imposes no adolescent-only restriction. bt-divergence: The frozen activity label uses किशोरी, restricting the source population 'girls' to adolescent girls and excluding younger girls. The frozen form is retained.

rows.section: How do I find CCCM content in the MSP?
rows.en: For example, CCCM actors may provide a space in which to conduct the activity and may have an important role in informing the community about when and where the activity will take place.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, CCCM का सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूले गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न स्थान उपलब्ध गराउन सक्छन् र गतिविधि कहिले तथा कहाँ सञ्चालन हुनेछ भन्नेबारे समुदायलाई जानकारी दिन उनीहरूको महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका हुन सक्छ।
rows.bt: For example, CCCM stakeholders can provide space to carry out the activity, and they may have an important role in informing the community about when and where the activity will take place.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Communication between MHPSS TWG and CCCM cluster, e.g. information sharing and discussions of areas for potential collaboration. At site level, ensuring that MHPSS is included in service mapping, monitoring of gaps, and coordination meetings.
rows.ne: MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (TWG) र CCCM क्लस्टरबीच सञ्चार गर्ने, उदाहरणका लागि सूचना आदानप्रदान गर्ने र सम्भावित सहकार्यका क्षेत्रबारे छलफल गर्ने। स्थलस्तरमा सेवाहरूको नक्साङ्कन, अपुग पक्षहरूको अनुगमन र समन्वय बैठकहरूमा MHPSS समावेश भएको सुनिश्चित गर्ने।
rows.bt: Communicate between the MHPSS technical working group (TWG) and the CCCM cluster, for example by exchanging information and discussing possible areas of collaboration. Ensure that MHPSS is included in site-level service mapping, monitoring of gaps and coordination meetings.

rows.bt: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide the programme.

rows.bt: Include MHPSS in multisectoral needs assessments carried out at the site.

rows.section: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.en: Section 2 activities (on programme design, implementing an M&E system, caring for staff and volunteers and supporting MHPSS competencies) should be implemented by all organizations delivering MHPSS activities.
rows.ne: MHPSS गतिविधिहरू सञ्चालन गर्ने सबै संस्थालाई खण्ड 2 का गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन गर्न सिफारिस गरिन्छ। यी गतिविधिहरू कार्यक्रमको डिजाइन, अनुगमन तथा मूल्याङ्कन (M&E) प्रणालीको कार्यान्वयन, कर्मचारी तथा स्वयंसेवकको हेरचाह र MHPSS सक्षमतामा सहयोग गर्नेसँग सम्बन्धित छन्।
rows.bt: All organizations conducting MHPSS activities are recommended to implement the activities in Section 2. These activities relate to programme design, implementation of monitoring and evaluation (M&E) systems, care of staff and volunteers, and supporting MHPSS competence.
rows.note: Competency wording is reused from the supplied activity-list candidate; it remains unreviewed. The back-translation makes implementation mandatory ('must'), whereas the source says 'should'. The revision expresses a recommendation while retaining all organizations and all listed components.

rows.bt: The following are programmatic activities that CCCM stakeholders are generally in a suitable position to carry out:
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring equivalent for 'CCCM actors' while retaining the distinction between delivering and contributing to activities.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that CCCM actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: 3.3 मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Clinical wording is reused verbatim from the supplied unreviewed activity-label candidate.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that CCCM actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Identifying and incorporating key MHPSS messages into CCCM activities and informational materials.
rows.ne: मुख्य MHPSS सन्देशहरू पहिचान गरी CCCM गतिविधि र सूचनामूलक सामग्रीमा समावेश गर्ने।
rows.bt: Identify key MHPSS messages and include them in CCCM activities and informational materials.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that CCCM actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.4 Support new and pre-existing group-based community MHPSS activities
rows.ne: 3.4 नयाँ तथा पहिलेदेखि सञ्चालित समूहमा आधारित सामुदायिक MHPSS गतिविधिलाई सहयोग गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.4 Support new and already ongoing group-based community MHPSS activities.
rows.note: Reuses the supplied unreviewed activity-label candidate.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that CCCM actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Providing communal space e.g. for social and recreational activities. Maintaining safe and accessible communal spaces at the site in which to conduct group-based community MHPSS activities. Communicating with site residents about the timings and locations of group-based community MHPSS activities. Supporting the integration of MHPSS into wider community groups, such as child protection committees, women’s groups, and governance structures, for example, by linking such groups with actors who can offer capacity building on MHPSS and peer support.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, सामाजिक तथा मनोरञ्जनात्मक गतिविधिहरू सञ्चालन गर्न सामुदायिक स्थल उपलब्ध गराउने। स्थलमा समूहमा आधारित सामुदायिक MHPSS गतिविधिहरू सञ्चालन गर्न सुरक्षित र पहुँचयोग्य सामुदायिक स्थलहरू कायम राख्ने। स्थलका बासिन्दासँग समूहमा आधारित सामुदायिक MHPSS गतिविधिहरू हुने समय र स्थानबारे संवाद गर्ने। बाल संरक्षण समितिहरू, महिला समूहहरू र शासनसम्बन्धी संरचनाजस्ता व्यापक सामुदायिक समूहहरूमा MHPSS को एकीकरणमा सहयोग गर्ने; उदाहरणका लागि, यस्ता समूहहरूलाई MHPSS र सहकर्मी सहयोगबारे क्षमता विकास गराउन सक्ने सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूसँग जोड्ने।
rows.bt: For example, provide a community space to carry out social and recreational activities. Maintain safe and accessible community spaces to carry out group-based community MHPSS activities at the site. Communicate with site residents about the times and places where group-based community MHPSS activities will take place. Support the integration of MHPSS into broader community groups such as child protection committees, women's groups and governance structures; for example, connect such groups with stakeholders who can build their capacity in MHPSS and peer support.
rows.note: The frozen T279 form सहकर्मी सहयोग can imply support between coworkers, while the source does not restrict peer support to an employment relationship. bt-divergence: The frozen सहकर्मी सहयोग denotes support among coworkers, whereas the source 'peer support' is not restricted to an employment relationship. The frozen form is retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that CCCM actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS considerations and actions
rows.ne: 3.1 मानवीय कर्ता र समुदायका सदस्यलाई MHPSS बारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने र MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष तथा कार्यका लागि पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS-related considerations and actions.
rows.note: Reuses the supplied unreviewed activity-label candidate.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that CCCM actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Collaborating with MHPSS experts to orient CCCM actors on MHPSS and interlinkages between MHPSS and CCCM. Contributing to and advocating for the provision of CCCM programming in ways that support mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.ne: CCCM सम्बद्ध पक्षलाई MHPSS र MHPSS तथा CCCM बीचका अन्तरसम्बन्धबारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्न MHPSS विशेषज्ञहरूसँग सहकार्य गर्ने। मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणलाई सहयोग पुग्ने तरिकाले CCCM कार्यक्रम सञ्चालन गर्न योगदान दिने र त्यसका लागि पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: Collaborate with MHPSS specialists to orient CCCM stakeholders on MHPSS and the interrelationships between MHPSS and CCCM. Contribute to conducting CCCM programmes in ways that support mental health and psychosocial well-being, and advocate for this.
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring equivalent for 'CCCM actors'. Clinical wording is reused from the supplied unreviewed activity-label candidate T100.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that CCCM actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Ensuring that site residents live in a dignified environment that promotes mental health and psychosocial well-being and is safe, secure, and physically, socially, and culturally appropriate. Ensuring that CCCM activities and services are accessible to and consider the specific needs of people with mental health conditions.
rows.ne: स्थलका बासिन्दा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याणलाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने तथा सुरक्षित, सुरक्षायुक्त र भौतिक, सामाजिक तथा सांस्कृतिक दृष्टिले उपयुक्त मर्यादित वातावरणमा बसोबास गर्छन् भन्ने सुनिश्चित गर्ने। मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्था भएका व्यक्तिहरूका लागि CCCM गतिविधिहरू र सेवाहरू पहुँचयोग्य छन् र तिनले ती व्यक्तिहरूका विशिष्ट आवश्यकताहरूलाई ध्यानमा राख्छन् भन्ने सुनिश्चित गर्ने।
rows.bt: Ensure that site residents live in a dignified environment that promotes mental health and psychosocial well-being and is safe, secure and appropriate from physical, social and cultural perspectives. Ensure that CCCM activities and services are accessible to people with mental health conditions and that they take those people's specific needs into account.
rows.note: The clinical population remains people with mental health conditions, without adding a requirement for impairment in daily functioning.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that CCCM actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills
rows.ne: 3.2 अग्रपंक्तिका कार्यकर्ता र सामुदायिक अगुवालाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग सीपमा अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills.
rows.note: Clinical wording is reused verbatim from the supplied unreviewed activity-label candidate.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that CCCM actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Organizing orientations on basic psychosocial support (e.g. psychological first aid) for site management teams, including the identification and referral of children and adults who may need MHPSS.
rows.ne: स्थल व्यवस्थापन टोलीहरूका लागि आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग (उदाहरणका लागि, [psychological first aid]) सम्बन्धी अभिमुखीकरणहरू आयोजना गर्ने र त्यसमा MHPSS आवश्यक पर्न सक्ने बालबालिका र वयस्कहरूको पहिचान गर्ने तथा उनीहरूलाई सम्बन्धित सेवामा पठाउने कार्य समावेश गर्ने।
rows.bt: Organize orientations on basic psychosocial support (for example, [psychological first aid]) for site management teams and include in them the identification of children and adults who may need MHPSS and referring them to relevant services.
rows.note: The named intervention remains in exact source English, and the identification and referral scope retains possible rather than definite need for MHPSS.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that CCCM actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: 3.6 Provide group activities for children’s mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: 3.6 बालबालिकाको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणका लागि सामूहिक गतिविधि प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.6 Provide group activities for children's mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Clinical wording is reused verbatim from the supplied unreviewed activity-label candidate.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that CCCM actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Providing safe and accessible communal spaces at the site for MHPSS group activities for children and adolescents and supporting their maintenance. Communicating with site residents about the timings and locations of available group activities for children and adolescents.
rows.ne: बालबालिका तथा किशोरकिशोरीका लागि MHPSS सामूहिक गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न स्थलमा सुरक्षित र पहुँचयोग्य सामुदायिक स्थलहरू उपलब्ध गराउने र तिनको मर्मतसम्भारमा सहयोग गर्ने। बालबालिका तथा किशोरकिशोरीका लागि उपलब्ध सामूहिक गतिविधिहरूको समय र स्थानबारे स्थलका बासिन्दासँग सञ्चार गर्ने।
rows.bt: Provide safe and accessible community spaces at the site to conduct MHPSS group activities for children and adolescents, and support their maintenance. Communicate with site residents about the times and locations of available group activities for children and adolescents.
rows.note: General safety guidance; review pending. Uses proposed recurring equivalents for 'communal spaces' and 'site residents', preserving both children and adolescents.

rows.bt: 3.9 Provide MHPSS through safe spaces for women and adolescent girls.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that CCCM actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:

rows.ne: महिला तथा किशोरीका लागि MHPSS गतिविधिहरू सञ्चालन गर्न स्थलमा सुरक्षित र पहुँचयोग्य सामुदायिक स्थलहरू उपलब्ध गराउने तथा तिनको मर्मतसम्भारमा सहयोग गर्ने। महिला तथा किशोरीका लागि सुरक्षित स्थलमा हुने MHPSS गतिविधिहरूको समय र स्थानबारे स्थलका बासिन्दासँग संवाद गर्ने।
rows.bt: Provide safe and accessible community spaces at the site to carry out MHPSS activities for women and adolescent girls, and support their maintenance. Communicate with site residents about the times and places of MHPSS activities taking place in safe spaces for women and adolescent girls.

rows.en: Rather, relevant organizations must coordinate and work together across sectors/AoRs to ensure that activities are implemented, and a comprehensive response is delivered.
